Asafo no mmɔ mpaeɛ
1 # Flp 4.6 Na afei, deɛ ɛdi ne nyinaa kan no, metu fo sɛ wɔnyɛ nkotosrɛ, mpaebɔ, odima ne aseda mma nnipa nyinaa; 2ahemfo ne wɔn a wɔdi tumi nyinaa, na yɛatena ase komm, na yɛn ho adwo yɛn, onyamesom pa ne abrabɔ a ɛho yɛ nyam nyinaa mu. 3#1 Ti 1.1; 4.10 Na yei yɛ, na ɛsɔ yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn 4#Hes 18.23; 2 Pe 3.9 a ɔpɛ sɛ wɔgye nnipa nyinaa nkwa na wɔba nokorɛ nimdeɛ mu no ani. 5#Rom 3.29-30; Heb 12.24 Na
Onyankopɔn koro na ɔwɔ hɔ,
ne Onyankopɔn ne nnipa ntamgyinafoɔ koro,
ɔno ne onipa Kristo Yesu,
6 # Gal 1.4; 2.20; Tito 2.14 a ɔde ne ho maa sɛ agyedeɛ maa nnipa nyinaa sɛ
ɛnyɛ adanseɛ ɛberɛ a wɔahyɛ mu. 7#2 Ti 1.11; Gal 2.7-8 Ɛno na wɔabɔ din ahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafoɔ ne ɔsomafoɔ (meka nokorɛ, menni atorɔ), amanaman mufoɔ kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ gyidie ne nokorɛ mu.
Asɔre mu abrabɔ
8Enti mepɛ sɛ mmarima bɔ mpaeɛ wɔ mmaa nyinaa, ma nsa a ɛho teɛ so, a abufuo anaa akyinnyeɛ nni mu. 9#1 Pe 3.3-5 Saa ara nso na mmaa nhyɛ ntadeɛ a ɛsɛ, mfa ani a ɛwu adeɛ ne adwenemuteɛ nkeka wɔn ho, ɛnyɛ mmɛsawɔ anaa sika anaa nhwene pa anaa ntadeɛ a ɛwɔ boɔ mu, 10#1 Ti 5.10 na mmom nnwuma pa a ɛsɛ mmaa a wɔyi onyamesom kyerɛ mu.
Ɔbaa hyɛ ɔbarima ase
11 # Efe 5.22 Mmaa nyɛ komm nsua asɛm no ahobrɛaseɛ nyinaa mu. 12#1 Ko 14.34; Gye 3.16 Ɔbaa deɛ, memma no kwan sɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ anaasɛ ɔnni ɔbarima so, na mmom ɔnyɛ komm. 13#Gye 1.27; 2.7; 2.22 Ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɔɔ Adam kane, ansa na Hawa redi hɔ. 14#Gye 3.6; 2 Ko 11.3 Na ɛnyɛ Adam na wɔdaadaa no, na ɔbaa no na wɔdaadaa no a ɔkɔtoo mmara; 15nanso sɛ ɔtena gyidie ne ɔdɔ ne ahoteɛ ne adwenemuteɛ mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa n’abawoɔ mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na afei, deɛ ɛdi ne nyinaa kan no, metu fo sɛ wɔnyɛ nkotosrɛ, mpaebɔ, odima ne aseda mma nnipa nyinaa; ahemfo ne wɔn a wɔdi tumi nyinaa, na yɛatena ase komm, na yɛn ho adwo yɛn, onyamesom pa ne abrabɔ a ɛho yɛ nyam nyinaa mu. Na yei yɛ, na ɛsɔ yɛn Agyenkwa Nyankopɔn a ɔpɛ sɛ wɔgye nnipa nyinaa nkwa na wɔba nokorɛ nimdeɛ mu no ani. Na
Onyankopɔn koro na ɔwɔ hɔ,
ne Onyankopɔn ne nnipa ntamgyinafoɔ koro,
ɔno ne onipa Kristo Yesu,
a ɔde ne ho maa sɛ agyedeɛ maa nnipa nyinaa sɛ
ɛnyɛ adanseɛ ɛberɛ a wɔahyɛ mu. Ɛno na wɔabɔ din ahyɛ me ɔsɛnkafoɔ ne ɔsomafoɔ (meka nokorɛ, menni atorɔ), amanaman mufoɔ kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ gyidie ne nokorɛ mu.

Enti mepɛ sɛ mmarima bɔ mpaeɛ wɔ mmaa nyinaa, ma nsa a ɛho teɛ so, a abufuo anaa akyinnyeɛ nni mu. Saa ara nso na mmaa nhyɛ ntadeɛ a ɛsɛ, mfa ani a ɛwu adeɛ ne adwenemuteɛ nkeka wɔn ho, ɛnyɛ mmɛsawɔ anaa sika anaa nhwene pa anaa ntadeɛ a ɛwɔ boɔ mu, na mmom nnwuma pa a ɛsɛ mmaa a wɔyi onyamesom kyerɛ mu.

Mmaa nyɛ komm nsua asɛm no ahobrɛaseɛ nyinaa mu. Ɔbaa deɛ, memma no kwan sɛ ɔnkyerɛkyerɛ anaasɛ ɔnni ɔbarima so, na mmom ɔnyɛ komm. Ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɔɔ Adam kane, ansa na Hawa redi hɔ. Na ɛnyɛ Adam na wɔdaadaa no, na ɔbaa no na wɔdaadaa no a ɔkɔtoo mmara; nanso sɛ ɔtena gyidie ne ɔdɔ ne ahoteɛ ne adwenemuteɛ mu a, wɔbɛgye no nkwa n’abawoɔ mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
